entities.name: War with Phyrexia
entities.description: An era centered on the invasion of Dominaria by Yawgmoth's Phyrexian forces, ending with Yawgmoth's defeat.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Ruler of Phyrexia who sought to assimilate all life into Compleation.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who prepared for the Phyrexian threat and sacrificed himself in the invasion.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, corrupted by Phyrexian influence in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: A series of artifacts and weapons Urza built to combat Phyrexia.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Effort to develop lineages able to wield the Legacy, such as Clan Capashen.

entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: A lineage developed to wield the Legacy.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane built by Yawgmoth as a base for invasion.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Plane corrupted by Yawgmoth's agents, leading to its downfall.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: Conflict during which Mishra was corrupted by Phyrexian influence.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion itself, with extensive loss of life, ended by Yawgmoth's defeat.

entities.name: Rift Era
entities.description: Period of instability that began after the war.

events.summary: Mishra is corrupted by Phyrexian influence during the Brothers' War.
events.quote: during which Urza’s brother, Mishra , was corrupted by Phyrexian influence

events.summary: Urza planeswalks to Phyrexia, learns of Yawgmoth's plans and begins extensive preparations.
events.quote: A planeswalk to the plane of Phyrexia confirmed the extent of Yawgmoth's plans

events.summary: Urza builds the Legacy and starts the Bloodline Project while Yawgmoth builds Rath and corrupts Serra's Realm.
events.quote: Yawgmoth expanded Phyrexia’s influence, constructing the plane of Rath as a base for invasion

events.summary: Through the defenders, Legacy wielders and Urza's sacrifice, Yawgmoth is defeated and Phyrexia repelled from Dominaria.
events.quote: Yawgmoth was defeated, and Phyrexia's influence on Dominaria was repelled.

events.summary: The war's end begins the Rift Era of instability from time magic and planar manipulation.
events.quote: The conclusion of the War with Phyrexia marked the start of the Rift Era

relations.quote: large-scale confrontations against the forces of Yawgmoth
Central to these preparations was the construction of the Legacy
constructing the plane of Rath as a base for invasion
